scope: federated non-Mundarica source-census and exact-locator ingestion sweep
principle: Search all requested classes; deterministically deduplicate before identity creation; promote only source-supported permitted evidence; preserve blocked/restricted/unverified material as explicit gaps.

query: Mundari grammar dictionary Osada Sinha Hoffmann Bhaduri CIIL primary manifestation
result: Known Bhaduri, Hoffmann, Osada, Sinha, CIIL and licensed WALS/Grambank streams were reconciled against existing audits. An unofficial Osada copy was discoverable but not used for content ingestion because lawful item-level rights were not established.

query: Munda Mundari Jharkhand peer reviewed linguistic ethnographic article 2019 2025 2026
result: Existing canonicalized recent article streams remain stronger for claim-bearing ingestion. Rau and Sidwell 2019 maritime-Munda article metadata was triangulated through Glottolog, but no new cultural claim or permanent identity was created in this pass.

query: Munda Mundari Jharkhand thesis dissertation institutional repository
result: Previously verified institutional dissertation streams remain active; no new thesis was promoted without stable repository identity and exact lawful manifestation.

query: Census India Mundari Munda C-16 C-17 ST-15 ST-16 LSI Jharkhand TRI repository
result: Existing official Census/LSI/TRI locators remain authoritative. Workbook/PDF byte acquisition, independent hashes and exact worksheet/page-image verification remain explicit gaps where retrieval is blocked.

query: Mundari Munda historical archive recordings BnF LSI archive
result: Existing BnF/LSI archival identities were reused. No historical recording, transcript or performer-derived content was ingested because item-level reuse and cultural-access boundaries remain unresolved.

query: Mundari newspaper magazine Jharkhand Nirang Pajhra hockey booklet
result: The 1941 hockey booklet remains supported by secondary journalistic evidence only; Nirang Pajhra still lacks authoritative registration/issue manifestation. Neither was falsely upgraded to primary evidence.

query: Mundari Munda authoritative language cultural web resources
result: Generic or unsourced pages were not used to create new claims. Stable institutional, standards, archive and repository pages were preferred.

query: Mundari dataset WALS Grambank Karya Rau 2019 Zenodo cognate
result: Felix Rau 2019 Zenodo dataset DOI 10.5281/zenodo.3380874 was verified at exact version/file level: version 0.1.0, 127 repository-described cognate sets including Mundari, CSV pMunda_cognate_set_2019-08-29.csv, repository-reported MD5 07e1d945a0fc6cafc4fc7afd3f1ff144. Licence value and independent checksum remain unresolved, so no rows were ingested and no permanent identity/count was assigned.

query: Mundari audio Karya BnF speech corpus recording
result: Known Karya/MunTTS and BnF streams retained. Participant/speaker secondary-use consent and cultural-access review remain separate from public technical access.

query: Munda Mundari Jharkhand documentary video EZCC
result: Existing EZCC/Wikimedia exact-timestamp CC BY file-level audit retained; file copyright permission is not treated as performer/community cultural permission.

query: Munda languages historical map Linguistic Survey of India Grierson
result: Existing historical LSI map locator remains preferred. No modern territorial or cultural-boundary claim was inferred from derivative maps.

query: Munda Mundari Jharkhand cultural media archive periodical audio video map
result: Relevant-media results were screened under copyright, consent, provenance, cultural-access and uncertainty controls; unsupported media remained discovery/gap material rather than evidence.
